segment.source:
::You find the captain silently and calmly observing a Dreadnought as it's clearing the big pile of rubble. He doesn't seem to mind the deafening sound of the large drill pulverizing the debris; in fact, he even appears to enjoy it, as evidenced by smiles which occasionally dash across his face. Your arrival snaps him out of his tranquil state, however.::
At ease, Corporal. Welcome to Epione Lab. I'm Captain Blackwall. I suspect Colonel Cathcart sent you here.<end>

segment.source: That is correct, sir.<end>

segment.source: To be frank, I expected... more than a single soldier. But, no matter, I hope you had no trouble finding us. I want you to listen carefully now, Corporal.<end>
segment.target: To be frank, I expected... more than a single soldier. But, no matter, I hope you had no trouble finding us. I want you to listen carefully now, Corporal.<end>

segment.source: The situation is as follows: Due to the extreme importance of Epione Lab, I had ordered regular and heavily armed patrols around the facility's perimeter ever since its establishment. Recently, not one, but several of our patrols reported some rather strange happenings. Silhouettes moving in the dark passageways, footsteps echoing the tunnels, voices... those sort of things. As if someone or *something* is circling and probing our perimeter.<end>
segment.target: The situation is as follows: Due to the extreme importance of Epione Lab, I had ordered regular and heavily armed patrols around the facility's perimeter ever since its establishment. Recently, not one, but several of our patrols reported some rather strange happenings. Silhouettes moving in the dark passageways, footsteps echoing the tunnels, voices... those sort of things. As if someone or *something* is circling and probing our perimeter.<end>

segment.source:
These occurrences have repeated several times already within a short period of time, and to be frank, Corporal - that makes me uneasy. Very much. My patrolmen were never able to catch anyone suspicious, but I'd be a fool to disregard their reports. We have many enemies in the South, but even regular bandits and other lowlife know they'd get shot to pieces if they were spotted this close to the facility. No, someone else must be behind this.
Therefore, I contacted Colonel Cathcart and requested aid.<end>

segment.source: What do you need me for, sir?<end>

segment.source: Corporal, pay attention, please. I want that area scrutinized. If even a centipede is missing a leg, I want to know about it.<end>

segment.source: I think that's clear enough. Do you have any further questions for me, Corporal, or are we done here?<end>

segment.source: No, sir. I'm on my way, sir.<end>

segment.source:
Perfect. Report to me once you've got something. Oh, and... since you're working alone, it might be wise to remain as stealthy as possible. That way, maybe you can spot our mysterious visitors - if they do exist - before they spot you.
That is all. Dismissed.<end>

segment.source: <end>

segment.source: I found a group of Free Drones hiding near Epione Lab. They breathe no more.<end>
segment.target: I found a group of Free Drones hiding near Epione Lab. They breathe no more.<end>

segment.source: Why is Epione Lab so important, sir?<end>
segment.target: Why is Epione Lab so important, sir?<end>

segment.source: To be frank, Corporal, I can't tell you. It's classified.<end>
segment.target: To be frank, Corporal, I can't tell you. It's classified.<end>

segment.source: But, I can tell you that it is extremely important for the future of all military operations in South Underrail. That's all you need to know for now. Any other questions?<end>

segment.source: You use Dreadnoughts to clear rubble?<end>

segment.source: Dreadnoughts are designed for that, Corporal. Other than having superior weaponry they also come equipped with incredibly powerful and durable drills. When you need to make an entry, you can drill your own way if the existing one doesn't *fit* your needs. ::He laughs.::<end>
